CLONE FLAGS (P1, __stage-setup — stageCloneflags)
  CLONE_NEWUSER
  CLONE_NEWNET
  CLONE_NEWNS

UID MAP
  0 <hostuid> 1
GID MAP
  0 <hostgid> 1  (GidMappingsEnableSetgroups=false)

DESCRIPTORS (fixed; nothing travels in the environment — fds.go)
  fd 3    control       SOCK_SEQPACKET socketpair, P1's end
  fd 4    lifeline      read end of an anonymous pipe; P0 holds the write end
  fd 5    bwrap-info    READ end of bwrap's --info-fd pipe; the stage parses it, P0 does not
  fd 6   .. sandbox     K descriptors, dup3'd to 3..3+K-1 in the bwrap child
  fd 62  .. slack       4 numbers left free for what the Go runtime opens BEFORE main and keeps
  fd 66   N-socket      AF_INET socket CREATED IN N; still answers for N after the move
  fd 67   netns-N       the descriptor P1 pins on N before it leaves (not CLOEXEC until __stage-serve)
  budget        K <= 56, checked on BOTH sides of the control socket (checkFDBudget)
  reservation   fd 66 and fd 67 are CLAIMED at P1's first instant (reserveParkingFDs, refused if already open)
  parking       the same two are dup3 TARGETS later; each is refused if its reservation is gone (requireFDReserved)

BWRAP UNSHARE SET under policy.NetnsStage (internal/policy/bwrap.go)
  --unshare-user
  --unshare-ipc
  --unshare-pid
  --unshare-uts
  --unshare-cgroup-try
  (omits --unshare-net: N already exists, pinned by P1 and handed to bwrap
   by the __innetns setns shim, before bwrap ever runs)
